name: Level-aware Decoding
definition: A module introducing level-specific sets of fusion and attribute-prediction MLPs (MLP^{(\ell)}_{fuse} and MLP^{(\ell)}_{attr}) that are fine-tuned specifically for LOD \ell to interpret modulated features optimally.
summary: Level-aware Decoding dynamically fine-tunes level-specific neural networks for each resolution, enabling efficient, high-fidelity 3D Gaussian Splatting without storing redundant attributes.
